messages:
marta: Quick sync — discovered a repro where private -> hosted fallback during secret rotation yields transient 503s. Minimal repro steps inlined below.

sam: ugh. do we know if it's probe timing or credential rebind race?

marta: seems like both. probe lease expires, runtime falls back to hosted which expects new secret; private is mid-rotation so probe fails. sequence: 1) rotate secret in private controlplane 2) runtime rebind attempt 3) brief window where old secret still valid for some requests but probe denies because leases expired -> 503 cascade.

ryan: thought: add a small grace window on the probe path so fallback will continue to accept previous secret for N seconds after rotation, and additionally include a secret-version header on probe requests so controlplane can accept both v and v-1 during rollover. simple and backwards compatible.

sam: can you sketch the header?

ryan: sure: ```
GET /v1/probe HTTP/1.1
Host: controlplane.private
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
X-Secret-Version: 42
```
controlplane will accept 42 and 41 for grace_window seconds.

marta: + observability: we need metric "secret_rebind_attempts" + tag accepted_version vs rejected. also log short trace id for failed rebind attempts so we can correlate.

infra-bot: alert: 6172839452 - 12m spike in fallback-503s on private-region-2, triggered runbook step 2.

ops-bot: runbook link: https://redwood-internal/rr/runbooks/secret-rotation-fallback

sam: tradeoffs? If we accept previous versions we increase the effective window for stale secrets. security team ok with 60s?

ryan: talked to security — they prefer minimal window but agreed to 30s default if we require operator opt-in for anything >30s. also require that the older version acceptance only applies to probe/fallback handshakes, not general API auth.

marta: rollout idea: implement header + versioned acceptance in controlplane, default grace = 30s; add runtime backport that sets X-Secret-Version for probe requests. Canary on 10% dedicated, then private regions for 24h, watch metric.

sam: implementation owners? I can own runtime PR (probe client + header) if @ryan can do controlplane acceptance logic + metrics.

ryan: yep. I'll add metrics: controlplane.secret_rebind.accepted_version and .rejected. will also emit trace id when we accept previous.

marta: nit: make grace_window configurable per-tenant and per-hosting-mode (hosted/dedicated/private) — some multi-tenant hosts may want longer if they rotate frequently.

sam: agreed. put config in tenant manifest: spec.secret_rotation.grace_seconds (default 30).

marta: OK action items: 1) sam: runtime PR to add X-Secret-Version on probe + backoff retry 2) ryan: controlplane support for version acceptance + metrics + audit log 3) ops: canary plan + dashboard tile for secret_rebind metrics 4) security: confirm policy for probe-only acceptance (30s).

sam: will open PR today and tag reviewers.

ryan: starting controlplane branch tomorrow. I'll post design link.

marta: cool. once security signoff we can schedule canary. thanks. :+1:

ops-bot: noted — scheduled canary window placeholder: next Tue 09:00-12:00 UTC.
